title: How do destination question cards, landmarks, the Tracker and the Wiki divide their jobs?
question: How do destination question cards, landmarks, the Tracker and the Wiki divide their jobs?
answer:
LD-4: Four pieces divide the jobs: Destination Questions preserve concept understanding and lineage; Landmarks connect the evolving feature/pillar account; Tracker generates the compact view; Wiki explains confirmed durable understanding in readable Markdown without WBIDs.
LD-22B: Landmark files and question cards are JSON structured records; landmark files hold the evolving alignment account and links, cards own questions/answers/history. Wiki pages are human-presentable Markdown explanations containing understanding confirmed enough for durable KB, with no WBIDs. Wiki is how the owner reads about the project; JSON is difficult for him to read.
LD-28: Four-piece model confirmed; flat destination-questions/ and landmarks/ JSON records. Workflow activities maintain sources and reasons/evidence; generated Tracker shows percentage distributions. Wiki readable durable Markdown without WBIDs, fed by several Specs. Landmark can precede and outlive Specs.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: LD-4, LD-22B, LD-28 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
